title: alchemilla hoppeana var. alpigena
intro: Alchemilla hoppeana var. alpigena, commonly known as Mountain Lady's Mantle, is a perennial plant species in the Rosaceae family, characterized by its rosettes of palmate leaves and small white flowers. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing swelling, soothing wounds, and acting as an expectorant. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in treating conditions like eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla hoppeana var. alpigena include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
